name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. He initially pursued a degree in astrophysics, fascinated by complex systems and data analysis. However, the roar of engines and the intricate technological ballet of Formula racing captivated him during a visit to a local race. He transitioned into IT, focusing on systems management and data acquisition, applying his analytical skills to optimize team performance.

At Prema Junior, Ricardo is known for his relentless pursuit of efficiency and reliability in the team's IT infrastructure. He believes that seamless data flow and robust systems are paramount to gaining a competitive edge, especially in junior categories where margins are razor-thin. He's a stickler for detail, often pushing his team to implement cutting-edge solutions and adhere to stringent security protocols.

Ricardo's calm demeanor under pressure is legendary. He's the one you want in the server room when systems crash minutes before a qualifying session. He combines technical expertise with a strategic mindset, making him an invaluable asset to the team. His perfectionism, while sometimes challenging for his colleagues, ultimately ensures the team's IT infrastructure operates at peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, even in the paddock.
Always carries a small notebook filled with system diagrams.
Has a habit of muttering code snippets under his breath when stressed.
